notes.title: Demo Ver 2.0
notes.content:
Hey there!

I've been working very hard on the game. I'm glad to say I've finished the construction of the second dungeon of six and in the midst of working on the third.

In the meantime I've gone back into the demo to change a whole bunch of things to create a better experience:

- music update with music from Paul Zimmer. Very SNES.
- controls update, with an update on the mapping of what buttons do (everyone expected A not B was for jumping), and improved speed on climbing
- change from STAMINA to GRIP limit. Not so significant in the first dungeon but definitely becomes a greater consideration factor.
- a save system so that the dungeon doesn't need to be completed in one sitting (phew!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103201/3ad1a04a90f49a1cffe6f5652c73186fdb8773d4.png[/img]

Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Update to Demo ver 1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103201/41780b38483ed7ec2c2e09566fff6a7b88e9cd70.png[/img]

There have been quite a few changes to the mechanics of Alchemist's Mountain Demo. 

[list]
[*] Sophia now runs automatically without needing to hold down a button
[*] Players will notice a new mechanic where hearts discovered at full health will fill a potion meter. When the potion meter is full, the max life will be increased.
[*] Changes to several dungeon rooms to fix design flaws and improve intuitive problem solving
[/list]

If you'd like to read up on the changes in detail do [url=https://discord.gg/evilartbunnystudios]join our Discord [/url]where we post weekly on the game's progress.

notes.title: Alchemist's Mountain Early Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103201/69290ddfa27b95295d0f995593d6f39223cf0444.png[/img]

Hey guys! The Alchemist's Mountain Demo is out. The Axolotl Beast awaits. And after watching a playtester or two go at it, I'm almost tempted to add souls-like to the genre ːsteammockingː

There are quite a number of known bugs with the current build that I'll be working to resolve. But it is in a playable state.

Remember to give feedback here on [url=https://discord.gg/evilartbunnystudios]the Discord channel [/url]for a  ( limited in number ) gift playtesting the demo and also getting a cool server title. 

Enjoy and see you soon.
